stage: P0-1 Stage A HandReader_RGB feasibility (technical only; no accuracy; synthetic input)

upstream.checkpoint_terms: the checkpoint is trained on ChicagoFSWild+; its use remains subject to the relevant dataset/checkpoint terms and is not necessarily covered by the code's Apache-2.0 licence
upstream.paper: arXiv 2505.10267, HandReader: Advanced Techniques for Efficient Fingerspelling Recognition

environment.env: isolated venv in the session scratch directory (not in the repo)
environment.python_interpreter: anaconda Python 3.11.7 x86_64 under Rosetta on Apple Silicon (same platform as the OpenFS baseline runs)
install_deviations: repo pins opencv-python(-headless) 4.10.0.82: no x86_64 macOS wheel for this Python; opencv-python-headless 4.9.0.80 used (albumentations Resize uses cv2)
repo installs torch 2.0.1 from the cu118 index; the CPU macOS wheels of torch 2.0.1 / torchvision 0.15.2 from PyPI used
only packages needed by the RGB inference path installed (no turbojpeg, decord, face_recognition, mediapipe, h5py)
antlr4-python3-runtime 4.9.3 (hydra/omegaconf dependency) installed from its pure-Python sdist

preprocessing.upstream_input: a directory of pre-cropped hand JPEG frames per clip (ChicagoFSWild+ crops from the Shi et al. 2019 hand localizer, per the paper); the repo contains NO crop-generation code
preprocessing.eval_transform: BGR->RGB, albumentations Normalize(mean=(0.485,0.456,0.406), std=(0.229,0.224,0.225)) THEN Resize(224,224), ToTensorV2 (exactly transfomrs_val in src/data/RGB/datasets.py)
preprocessing.batching: frames of all clips concatenated along dim 0 (sum T, 3, 224, 224) with input_lengths; TSAM shifts per clip using those lengths
preprocessing.stage_a_consequence: Stage A must supply its own hand crops (frozen MediaPipe pipeline); this is a crop-source shift vs training and must be reported as such

synthetic_forward.input: 24 synthetic 224x224 RGB frames (white canvas, moving dark rectangle, red disc); no benchmark, reviewer or real-world content

decoding.decoded_strings: not recorded as results: synthetic input, semantically meaningless

decoding_notes.tester_default: RGBTester computes both greedy and beam (beam 5, lm_beta 0.4, ins_gamma 1.2); with scorer=None, lm_beta and ins_gamma have no effect, so beam is plain CTC prefix merging
decoding_notes.greedy_quirk: upstream greedy_decode skips a letter equal to the previous emitted letter whenever 2+ letters are already emitted, even across a blank, so legitimate double letters (e.g. 'll') can be suppressed; beam_decode has no such rule

frozen_for_stage_a.primary: CTC beam search, beam 5, no language model (beam_decode, scorer None)
frozen_for_stage_a.not_claimed: beam is not claimed to be more accurate on our data
frozen_for_stage_a.statement: This decoder choice was frozen before any Stage A evaluation output was produced and therefore was not selected based on benchmark accuracy.

portability_patches.what: make_resnet(pretrained=True) -> constructed without the ImageNet download
portability_patches.why: avoid a network fetch; those weights are overwritten by the strict checkpoint load

portability_patches.what: torch.Tensor.cuda() returns the tensor unchanged (stays on CPU)
portability_patches.why: src/models/modules/tsm_resnet.py:452 allocates the zero padding buffer with a hard-coded .cuda(); the only CUDA call on the RGB inference path

caveats: no crop-generation code upstream: our MediaPipe crops differ from the training crops
only 2 public commits; training/eval csv layout undocumented
